name: Iconic Halloween Costumes 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Iconic Halloween Costumes is a fashion dress-up game where you help three best friends prepare for a spooky and stylish Halloween adventure! Choose from a variety of creative looks, including royal Glinda-inspired gowns, Bridgerton-style elegance, edgy Beetlejuice vibes, or trendy cowgirl-chic outfits.
